summary.intent: Complete Phase 20 (Vault Migration) gap closure by removing dead migration code post-migration, then address PR review comments from CodeRabbit and Copilot.
summary.outcome: Phase 20 fully completed with 9/9 verification truths passing, GAP-01 resolved, 143 regression tests passed, all 6 CodeRabbit and 3 Copilot review threads resolved with fixes committed and pushed.

repo: Vault v2 migration is complete — server stores zero crypto material, all vault secrets live exclusively in IPFS v2 blobs. DB columns (encrypted_root_folder_key, encrypted_root_ipns_private_key, migrated_at) are permanently dropped.

InitVaultDto and VaultExportDto now only contain ownerPublicKey and rootIpnsName — any code still sending encryptedRootFolderKey/encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey will be rejected by NestJS whitelist validation.
recovery.html is a standalone HTML file (no bundler) — helpers like fetchWithTimeout and escapeHtml must be injected as plain script functions within the file itself.
The SDK E2E test harness (test-harness.ts) had not been updated to match the simplified DTO after gap closure execution, causing CI failures despite unit tests passing.
Phase 20 had 6 total plans: 4 original (01-04) + 2 gap-closure (05-06). Plans 01-04 already had SUMMARYs so execute-phase correctly skipped them.
The desktop Rust InitVaultRequest and fetch_and_decrypt_vault were simplified to remove non-migrated branches — only ownerPublicKey + rootIpnsName remain.

code.finding: Deserializer needed zero-length key_len rejection; CodeRabbit caught this. Serializer also needed the same guard (Copilot follow-up).
All fetch() calls in IPFS resolution and content fetch lacked AbortController timeouts — wrapped with fetchWithTimeout helper (15s for IPNS, 30s for content).
rootIpnsName flowed into innerHTML unsanitized. Fixed with format validation (^k[0-9a-z]{20,}$) and escapeHtml helper for exportedAt/derivationInfo.
Export-file path still attempted to decrypt encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey unconditionally; made optional since v2 format no longer requires it.
Rust serialize and deserialize both needed zero-length key validation to match TypeScript blob.ts parity. Existing test_zero_length_key updated to expect Err rather than Ok.
encryptVaultKeys import and usage in vault init request body not cleaned up during plan execution — caused SDK E2E CI failures post-merge.
GET /vault and GET /vault/export assertions for encryptedRootFolderKey/encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey needed removal to match simplified DTOs.

workflow: GSD gap-closure mode (--gaps-only) reads VERIFICATION.md gaps and skips research entirely — appropriate when the gap is well-understood (dead code removal).
plan-phase with --gaps creates plans with gap_closure: true frontmatter; execute-phase with --gaps-only filters to only those plans, skipping already-completed ones via SUMMARY.md presence check.
Spot-checking agent completion via SUMMARY.md existence + git log grep is reliable for detecting classifyHandoffIfNeeded false failures.
PR review resolution workflow: CodeRabbit reviews arrive first, Copilot reviews can appear after a follow-up push — may require running resolve-pr-comments twice in a session.
NestJS whitelist validation (forbidNonWhitelisted) causes hard DTO rejection of extra properties — downstream consumers must be updated atomically with DTO changes or CI will break.

friction: SDK E2E tests failed in CI because test-harness.ts was not updated during plan execution — the gap closure plans cleaned up production code but missed test fixture cleanup.
Verifier agent wrote VERIFICATION.md to a different working directory than expected, requiring multiple bash path checks to locate the file.
Copilot review comments arrived after the initial CodeRabbit resolution pass, requiring a second resolve-pr-comments run.
The pre-wave dependency check found no key-links in plan frontmatter (links were in plan body) — dependency verification silently passed without meaningful validation.
Committing phase docs required multiple bash attempts because the verifier had already committed some artifacts, causing no-op commit errors.
open_items: 2 items flagged for human verification in live environment: (1) new user init publishes v2 blob to IPFS before API registration, (2) recovery tool IPFS-direct path with real vault and real IPFS gateway.
Phase 23 is next — discuss-phase and plan-phase not yet started.

PROJECT.md updated to reflect Phase 20 completion but downstream consumers of the simplified vault API (mobile clients, third-party integrations if any) should be audited for stale crypto field usage.
